facts.value: Firstly, read the section titled 'Understanding the page for each country' before navigating to the relevant country page.
Under the section 'What is the minimum I need?' on the country pages, please use the '2 H5 section' for all Level 8 courses at University of Limerick.
To use Tables 1 Subject Comparisons and 2 Points Conversion, please review the specific subject and points requirements for each course on the Course Pages or the Undergraduate Prospectus.
Applicants presenting older qualifications or qualifications not listed in the document should submit a query, attaching scanned copies of those qualifications.
